fields.hero_h1: Window Glass Repair in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Cracked, chipped, or damaged window glass? We repair it fast across the GTA, and we are repair-first, so you keep your frame and your money.
fields.overview_body:
A cracked or chipped pane is almost always a repair, not a new window. SolidGuard does window glass repair across Toronto and the GTA: where the frame is sound, we swap the glass into your existing frame, same or next day, so you keep the window you have.

From a single-pane glazing crack to a damaged double-pane sealed unit, we re-glaze, replace the pane, and finish the putty bead so the repair is clean and sealed. Cracked window glass only gets worse over time, with drafts, weaker glass, and rising heating bills, so the sooner it is fixed the better. Same-day window glass repair in Toronto is available for most jobs, with police-cleared technicians and a workmanship warranty.
fields.repairfirst_body: If your frame is sound, you do not need a new window. We replace just the glass pane and you keep the difference. We handle full window replacement too, and tell you straight when it is the right call.

faqs.question: Can a cracked window be repaired, or does it need replacing?
faqs.answer: Small chips and cracks can sometimes be repaired. If the pane is too far gone, we swap just the glass into your existing frame, which is faster and usually less than a new window.

faqs.question: How much does window glass repair cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size and type of glass. We give you a firm quote before any work, with no charge until you approve it. For typical ranges, try our cost estimator.

faqs.question: How fast can you come out?
faqs.answer: Same or next day across most of the GTA. If the opening is unsafe, tell us and we will prioritize it.

faqs.question: Do you replace just the glass or the whole window?
faqs.answer: We are repair-first. If the frame is good, we replace just the glass. If a full replacement is genuinely the right call, we tell you straight.

faqs.question: Is the repair guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every job carries a workmanship warranty, and if something is not right we come back and make it right.

faqs.question: Do you repair single-pane glass and older glazing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle single-pane glass repair, re-glazing of older wood and aluminum frames, and re-bedding the putty bead. If the glass is beyond repair, we swap in a new pane, same-day where possible.

fields.final_cta_heading: Cracked window glass? We are on our way.
